q: 麦当劳最近一季表现怎么样？

user_answers.answer_sentence: 整体评价：这是一个“利润表现强于销售、地区表现分化”的季度。
user_answers.question: 麦当劳最近一季表现怎么样？

answer_fragments.text: 整体评价：这是一个“利润表现强于销售、地区表现分化”的季度。收入增长1%，而GAAP营业利润和净利润分别增长7%和9%；但全球同店销售仅增长1.5%，美国同店销售及客流仍下降。因此，盈利表现稳健，但需求端尚不能称为全面强劲复苏。
截至2026年11月16日，在本次可用资料中，麦当劳最新已披露季度为截至2026年9月30日的2026年第三季度；业绩公告于11月4日发布，相关10-Q于11月6日提交。
证据范围仅为截至该日的有限本地四份文件目录，本次未联网核验，因此不能宣称已穷尽麦当劳截至11月16日的全部披露。
第三季度合并收入为71.57亿美元，同比增长1%；按固定汇率计算也增长1%。这些是公司业绩公告直接披露的数字。
第三季度GAAP营业利润为35.95亿美元，同比增长7%。
第三季度GAAP净利润为24.86亿美元，同比增长9%。
第三季度GAAP摊薄每股收益为3.51美元，同比增长10%；固定汇率下增长11%。
剔除本季5,600万美元及上年同期3,900万美元的净税前费用后，公司披露的非GAAP营业利润为36.51亿美元，同比增长8%；这些费用主要与“Accelerating the Organization”重组有关，调整后数字不应与GAAP口径混用。
按公司对上述费用的税后调整口径，第三季度非GAAP净利润为25.29亿美元，同比增长10%。
第三季度非GAAP摊薄每股收益为3.57美元，同比增长11%，上年同期为3.22美元。
第三季度全球同店销售同比增长1.5%，上年同期披露的同比增幅为3.6%，显示本季同店增长较为温和。
美国第三季度同店销售同比下降0.2%。公司解释为同店客流下降，基本被客单价增长抵消；这意味着美国需求端仍有压力，不能把盈利增长等同于客流全面恢复。
国际直营市场第三季度同店销售同比增长1.4%；公司称多数市场实现正增长，德国和澳大利亚领跑，法国表现形成部分拖累。
国际发展许可市场第三季度同店销售同比增长4.2%；公司称各地理区域均为正增长，日本表现领先，但中国同店销售下降形成部分抵消。
对于剔除上述费用后的第三季度营业利润增长，管理层主要归因于销售带动的加盟餐厅利润增加，以及各分部其他营业收入提高。这是公司对经营驱动的解释，并非本次独立量化的利润变动归因。
管理层表示，在采取价值优惠措施后，美国业务随季度推进有所改善，并将继续强化当前业务、投资未来增长；这属于管理层的定性判断，不代表已证明美国客流恢复增长。
前瞻风险方面，10-Q提示通胀及宏观经济变化可能影响消费者可支配收入和支出，商品与人工成本波动可能影响餐厅盈利。这些属于风险披露，不能据此断定它们就是本季业绩变化的实际原因。

McDONALD'S REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS
•Global Systemwide sales* increased 4% to over $38 billion for the quarter
•Consolidated operating income increased 7% and adjusted operating income increased 8% for the quarter
•Systemwide sales to loyalty members across 70 loyalty markets were $41 billion for the trailing twelve-month period and more than $11 billion for the quarter
CHICAGO, IL - McDonald's Corporation today announced results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
“McDonald’s delivered another quarter of global growth, with solid performance across much of our international business. In the U.S., we're encouraged by improvement as the quarter progressed following our intervention on value,” said Chris Kempczinski, Chairman and CEO. “We’re focused on building from here, strengthening the business today and investing in the next chapter of growth.”
Third quarter financial performance:
•Global comparable sales increased 1.5%:
•U.S. decreased 0.2%
•International Operated Markets increased 1.4%
•International Developmental Licensed Markets increased 4.2%
•Consolidated revenues increased 1% (1% in constant currencies).
•Systemwide sales increased 4% (4% in constant currencies).
•Consolidated operating income increased 7% (7% in constant currencies). Results reflected pre-tax charges of $56 million and $39 million for the current year and prior year, respectively, primarily related to restructuring charges associated with Accelerating the Organization. Excluding these current and prior year charges, consolidated operating income increased 8% (8% in constant currencies).**
•Diluted earnings per share was $3.51, an increase of 10% (11% in constant currencies). Excluding the current year charges described above of $0.06 per share, diluted earnings per share was $3.57, an increase of 11% (11% in constant currencies) when also excluding prior year charges.**
•The Company declared a 4% increase in its quarterly cash dividend to $1.93 per share.
*Refer to page 4 for a definition of Systemwide sales.
**Refer to pages 2 and 3 for additional details on our results for the third quarter 2026 and 2025.

MACROECONOMIC AND MARKET CONDITIONS
Unfavorable general economic conditions could adversely affect our business and financial results.
Our results of operations are substantially affected by economic conditions, including inflationary pressures, which can vary significantly by market and can impact consumer disposable income levels and spending habits. Economic conditions can be impacted by a variety of factors, including hostilities, epidemics, pandemics and actions taken by governments to manage national and international economic matters, whether through austerity, stimulus measures or trade measures, and initiatives intended to control wages, unemployment, credit availability, inflation, taxation and other economic drivers. Sustained adverse economic conditions or periodic adverse changes in economic conditions put pressure on our operating performance and business continuity disruption planning, and our business and financial results may suffer as a result.
Our results of operations are also affected by fluctuations in currency exchange rates, and unfavorable currency fluctuations could adversely affect reported earnings.
Health epidemics or pandemics could adversely affect our business and financial results.
Health epidemics or pandemics have in the past and may in the future impact macroeconomic conditions, consumer behavior, labor availability and supply chain management, as well as local operations in impacted markets, all of which can adversely affect our business, financial results and outlook.

claims.text: 剔除本季5,600万美元及上年同期3,900万美元的净税前费用后，公司披露的非GAAP营业利润为36.51亿美元，同比增长8%；这些费用主要与“Accelerating the Organization”重组有关，调整后数字不应与GAAP口径混用。

critic_verdict.basis: 营业利润调节表季度列为GAAP 3,595加费用56等于非GAAP 3,651百万美元，上年为3,357加39等于3,396百万美元，披露增长8%。公告说明两年费用主要与相关重组有关，草稿正确区分调整后与GAAP。

claims.text: 美国第三季度同店销售同比下降0.2%。公司解释为同店客流下降，基本被客单价增长抵消；这意味着美国需求端仍有压力，不能把盈利增长等同于客流全面恢复。

critic_verdict.basis: 美国同店销售为负0.2%；公司紧接表格说明同店客流下降、正向客单增长基本抵消。需求仍有压力及不能认定客流全面恢复的判断与负客流事实一致，未将盈利增长解释为客流增长。

claims.text: 对于剔除上述费用后的第三季度营业利润增长，管理层主要归因于销售带动的加盟餐厅利润增加，以及各分部其他营业收入提高。这是公司对经营驱动的解释，并非本次独立量化的利润变动归因。

critic_verdict.basis: 非GAAP营业利润调节表后的说明明确将季度及九个月增长主要归于销售带动的加盟利润增加和各分部其他营业收入提高；草稿限定为管理层解释，未声称已独立量化，也未将仅涉及九个月的管理费用抵消因素移至季度。

claims.text: 管理层表示，在采取价值优惠措施后，美国业务随季度推进有所改善，并将继续强化当前业务、投资未来增长；这属于管理层的定性判断，不代表已证明美国客流恢复增长。

critic_verdict.basis: CEO原话称价值措施后美国表现随季度推进改善，并强调强化当前业务及投资下一阶段增长；草稿保留管理层定性归属，不将改善升级为客流已恢复正增长。

claims.text: 前瞻风险方面，10-Q提示通胀及宏观经济变化可能影响消费者可支配收入和支出，商品与人工成本波动可能影响餐厅盈利。这些属于风险披露，不能据此断定它们就是本季业绩变化的实际原因。

critic_verdict.basis: 宏观风险段明确通胀可能影响可支配收入与消费；成本风险段说明商品和人工波动可能影响餐厅盈利，后者具体涉及自营餐厅。草稿仅作前瞻风险概述，未将其认定为本季度实际变动原因。

claims.text: 整体评价：这是一个“利润表现强于销售、地区表现分化”的季度。收入增长1%，而GAAP营业利润和净利润分别增长7%和9%；但全球同店销售仅增长1.5%，美国同店销售及客流仍下降。因此，盈利表现稳健，但需求端尚不能称为全面强劲复苏。

critic_verdict.basis: 季度收入增长1%、GAAP营业利润增长7%、净利润增长9%，支持利润增速高于销售；全球同店增长1.5%、美国同店负0.2%且客流下降，结合国际分部正增长支持地区分化及不能认定全面需求复苏的分析。
